mostWorthwhile.text: Inspecting the red blood cells revealed reversible oxygen binding and connected oxygen release to working tissues; the planned cutaway makes that relationship concrete.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add red cells to the plasma mixture failed without explaining what was missing, making the assembly sequence confusing.

surprise.text: The red cells had to bind oxygen before joining the sample, despite blood also carrying red cells when they are not oxygen-loaded.

arbitrary.text: Requiring white cells and platelets to join plasma before red cells, and oxygen to bind before assembly, felt like a game constraint rather than an explained biological necessity.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the planned illustrations connect blood components to oxygen transport clearly, though I would hope for less restrictive assembly ordering.
